metrics.name: Recall@K
metrics.formula: Count(rank(q) <= K for q in Q_ans) / |Q_ans|
metrics.interpretation: Fraction of answerable queries where the correct modern target symbol appears in the top-K returned ranking.

metrics.name: Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR@K)
metrics.formula: (1 / |Q_ans|) * sum(1 / rank(q) for q in Q_ans where 1 <= rank(q) <= K, else 0)
metrics.interpretation: Harmonic mean rank of the target symbol. Heavily rewards placing target at rank 1 (1.0), rank 2 (0.5), or rank 3 (0.33).

metrics.name: Precision@5
metrics.interpretation: Precision under single-target assumption where retrieving 1 target in top-5 yields 0.20.

metrics.name: False Positive Rate (FPR) / False Answer Rate on Category D
metrics.formula: Count(top1.score >= tau for q in Q_neg) / |Q_neg|
metrics.interpretation: Fraction of unanswerable queries incorrectly answered because top candidate score exceeded abstention threshold.
metrics.status: MEASURED_WITH_FLAW_DISCLOSED (Historic 0.20 threshold invalidated; calibrated dev threshold reported)

metrics.name: No-Result Accuracy
metrics.interpretation: Fraction of unanswerable queries correctly rejected/abstained.

metrics.name: Predecessor Identification Accuracy
metrics.interpretation: Accuracy with which top-ranked symbol explicitly retains the correct predecessor identifier in its lineage profile.

metrics.name: Average Retrieval Latency
metrics.interpretation: Mean end-to-end latency to process query and rank candidate pool.

metrics.name: Downstream Context Utility (LLM Pass Rate)
metrics.formula: Count(LLM answer correct given retrieved context) / |Q_downstream|
metrics.interpretation: Proportion of downstream coding tasks solved by an LLM when provided top-K retrieved symbols as context.
metrics.status: NOT_YET_MEASURED (Protocol approval and downstream task execution required)
